name: ExFractals
summary: ExFractals is an Expert Advisor that trades based on Bill Williams' Fractal breakout signals. It enters long positions when price breaks above an upward fractal and enters short positions when price breaks below a downward fractal, using the fractal level as a key support/resistance reference for trade execution and stop placement.
summary_zh: ExFractals是一个基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形突破信号的专家顾问。当价格突破上分形时做多，当价格跌破下分形时做空，利用分形水平作为关键支撑/阻力参考进行交易执行和止损设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标的突破交易。分形由至少5根K线组成，中间K线的最高价（上分形）或最低价（下分形）为极值点。入场条件为：当价格收盘突破上分形时开多单，当价格收盘跌破下分形时开空单，这是一种典型的突破策略逻辑。出场条件通常使用分形的另一侧作为止损参考，即多单止损设于下分形下方，空单止损设于上分形上方，部分版本也会加入止盈目标或跟踪止损。仓位管理方面，EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算，但具体实现取决于参数设置。资金管理方面，该EA的风险主要在于分形突破可能产生假突破信号导致频繁止损，尤其是在震荡行情中分形信号密集且可靠性较低。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator breakout trading. A fractal consists of at least 5 bars where the middle bar forms an extreme high (up fractal) or extreme low (down fractal). Entry conditions are: a long position is opened when price closes above an up fractal, and a short position is opened when price closes below a down fractal, which is a classic breakout strategy logic. Exit conditions typically use the opposite fractal as a stop-loss reference - long stops placed below the down fractal and short stops placed above the up fractal, with some versions also adding take-profit targets or trailing stops. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage, depending on the parameter configuration. Money management risk centers on the fact that fractal breakouts can produce false signals leading to frequent stop-losses, especially in ranging markets where fractal signals are dense and less reliable.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when money management is disabled)

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示使用分形止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 跟踪止损点数，0表示不使用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单

parameters.name: TimeFrame
parameters.description: 分形计算的时间周期，0为当前周期

pros: 分形是经典且被广泛认可的技术指标，策略逻辑清晰易懂
使用分形作为止损参考具有客观性，避免了主观设定止损的随意性
突破策略在趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉趋势的延续
策略参数较少，简化了优化和回测过程
pros_en: Fractals are a classic and widely recognized technical indicator with clear and easy-to-understand strategy logic
Using fractals as stop-loss references provides objectivity, avoiding arbitrary stop placement
Breakout strategies perform well in trending markets, capable of capturing trend continuation
Few strategy parameters simplify optimization and backtesting processes
cons: 在震荡行情中分形信号频繁出现，容易产生假突破导致连续亏损
分形信号具有滞后性，确认分形需要至少2根K线的延迟
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分趋势行情和震荡行情
止损如果基于分形位置，在极端波动时止损距离可能过大导致单笔风险过高
cons_en: In ranging markets, fractal signals appear frequently, easily producing false breakouts leading to consecutive losses
Fractal signals have inherent lag, requiring at least 2 bars of delay to confirm a fractal
Lacks a trend filter, unable to distinguish between trending and ranging market conditions
If stops are based on fractal levels, stop distance may be excessively large during extreme volatility, leading to high per-trade risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），仅在趋势行情中交易分形突破，减少震荡市的假信号
加入仓位管理模块，根据分形止损距离动态调整手数以保持固定风险比例
增加多时间周期确认，要求高一级时间周期趋势方向一致才入场
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or MA direction) to only trade fractal breakouts in trending markets, reducing false signals in ranging conditions
Add a position sizing module that dynamically adjusts lots based on fractal stop distance to maintain a fixed risk percentage per trade
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring the higher timeframe trend direction to align before entering

risk_points: 缺乏趋势过滤器可能在震荡市中频繁止损
分形止损距离不确定，可能导致单笔风险不可控
未检测是否有持仓限制，可能同方向重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
Fractal-based stop distance is variable, potentially leading to uncontrolled per-trade risk
May lack position check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction

It enters long positions when price breaks above an upward fractal and enters short positions when price breaks below a downward fractal, using the fractal level as a key support/resistance reference for trade execution and stop placement.
